findings.title: Test-only sink seam leaks into the production API
findings.detail: At crates/blit-core/src/transfer_session/local.rs:227 and crates/blit-core/src/transfer_session/mod.rs:24, the concurrency-test seam is shipped as a public LocalMirrorOptions field and re-exported type, plus a runtime branch at local.rs:780. This unnecessarily changes the public struct API, can break downstream exhaustive construction, and lets callers bypass the normal FsTransferSink/NullSink configuration that enforces dry-run, checksum, and resume behavior. Keep the override behind cfg(test) on a private inner session runner; the public run_local_session can delegate to that runner so the test still exercises the load-bearing sink_workers wiring without shipping the test seam.
